---
title: "easydta: single-test DTA meta-analysis (anti-CCP)"
output: html_document
---

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(easydta, ggplot2, grid, gridExtra)
```

```{r load_data}
path <- system.file("extdata/anti_ccp.csv", package = "easydta")
d <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(d)
```

```{r reshape}
long <- dta_reshape(d,
                    tp = "TP", fp = "FP", fn = "FN", tn = "TN",
                    studlab = "studlab",
                    extra   = "generation")
head(long)
```

```{r fit}
fit <- dta_fit_single(long, nAGQ = 1)
print(fit)
```

```{r heterogeneity}
dta_heterogeneity(fit)
```

```{r save_forest}
png("forest_anti_ccp.png", width = 1400, height = 1000, res = 150)
dta_forest(fit, d, studlab = "studlab")
dev.off()
```

```{r save_sroc}
png("sroc_anti_ccp.png", width = 1200, height = 1000, res = 150)
p <- dta_sroc(fit, auc_method = "trapz")
print(p)
dev.off()
```
